entries.title: Psalms 11:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David. I put my trust in the LORD; how can you say to me, Flee [like] a bird to the mountains;

entries.title: Psalms 11:2
segments: for lo, the wicked bend [their] bow; they make ready their arrow on the string, so that they may secretly shoot at the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 11:3
segments: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

entries.title: Psalms 11:4
segments: The LORD [is] in His holy temple; the LORD's throne [is] in Heaven; His eyes behold, His eyelids examine the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 11:5
segments: The LORD tries the righteous; but His soul hates the wicked and the one who loves violence,

entries.title: Psalms 11:6
segments: On the wicked He shall rain snares, fire and brimstone; and a horrible tempest [shall be] the portion of their cup.

entries.title: Psalms 11:7
segments: For the righteous LORD loves righteousness; His face looks on the upright.
